vision.title: 🎯 Our Vision
vision.body: SparringCompanion is not a coach, it's a companion. The app supports combat sports practitioners in autonomous development, acting as a reflective mirror rather than a prescriptive authority.

philosophy.title: 🧠 Learning Philosophy
philosophy.autonomy_body: Autonomy is central. Every practitioner has a unique context (body, style, opponents, goals). The app helps you observe, analyze, and adapt your own practice.
philosophy.failfast_title: Error as a Source of Learning
philosophy.failfast_body: We encourage experimentation and failing fast. Each difficult session provides valuable information for adjusting your hypotheses.
philosophy.ecological_body: Inspired by the Constraints‑Led Approach: learning emerges from individual, environmental, and task constraints. The app surfaces difficulties and patterns to enable true individualization and helps shift from System 1 (intuitive) to System 2 (reflective).

features.title: 📱 What the App Offers (Current Version)
features.journal_body: A post‑session form focused on observation and feeling; your history becomes a mirror for your patterns.
features.dashboard_body: Frequency, trends, calendar – statistics that inform without judging.
features.reflection_body: Exploratory questions rather than judgment; the app asks questions, you find your own answers.

whyJournal.title: 🔬 Why a Training Journal?
whyJournal.metacog_body: Journals strengthen metacognitive skills that distinguish experts from novices.
whyJournal.ecodynamics_body: Variability is not an error; it enables adaptation. Documenting sessions reveals your personal solutions.
whyJournal.consolidation_body: Post‑session reflection supports long‑term memory and the identification of actionable patterns.
